name: Mesh name
history: Messages last until this service stops.
publicEventsPaused: Public messages are paused during this game session.
eventRouteNotReady: The connection is getting ready. Try again shortly.
eventRouteGameActive: End the current game connection, then try again.
eventRouteActive: Public messaging is already in use. Try again when it is available.
eventRouteNotAuthorized: Relay messages aren't allowed for this connection.
eventDirectRequired: This contact needs a direct connection for messaging.
eventRouteFailed: Could not connect to public messaging. Try again.
sendFailed: Message was not acknowledged. Your draft is kept.
gameRequired: Choose a game for this extension.
composeNoGameFailed: Could not generate a draft. Try selecting a game.
temporaryEffect: Disconnects the contact service and starts a separate temporary identity. Your saved identity and contacts stay on this device. This does not change game connections.
returnSavedEffect: Disconnects the contact service, deletes temporary contacts and messages, and restores your saved identity.
keyBoundContact: Contacts are matched by full Mesh ID. Verify that ID with your contact.
